35594.a_level: GCE A-levels: minimum score 7 from best 2-3 H2-level subjects (Singapore-style scale)
35594.prerequisite_maths: Mathematics Methods (or equivalent) and Physical Sciences (Chemistry or Physics, or equivalent)
